profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Dallas, TX, with 4 years of experience specializing in React & React Native. My mission is building high-performance, user-centric applications. With experience in developing scalable, maintainable, and intuitive web and mobile solutions, I focus on delivering seamless user experiences through clean architecture and efficient code.



I thrive in fast-paced environments, solving complex challenges, and collaborating with teams to create applications that not only work well but feel amazing to use. Whether it's optimizing performance, integrating APIs, or crafting pixel-perfect UI components, I love turning ideas into reality with modern development practices and best-in-class technologies.



Always eager to learn, improve, and push boundaries, I’m passionate about staying up to date with the latest advancements in the React ecosystem, mobile development, and scalable software architectures.



Experience

● Mobile Development – End-to-end development and deployment of iOS & Android apps using React Native, with hands-on experience in Xcode, Android Studio, and Expo.

● Web Development – Crafting modern, responsive, and scalable React & Next.js applications with a focus on performance and usability.

● State Management – Expertise in MobX State Tree (MST), Redux, and React Context API for managing complex application states efficiently.

● Backend & APIs – Strong proficiency in Node.js, tRPC, and Prisma, designing scalable backend services and integrating REST & GraphQL APIs.

● Industry Solutions – Help built a finance application focused on secure user authentication during payment processes, enhancing transaction security and user experience. Architected and developed a point-of-sale (POS) system for the cannabis industry, ensuring compliance and seamless transactions.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead engineering efforts for The Happy Camper’s full-stack RV technology platform. This includes development across the company’s mobile application, admin portal, backend systems, and infrastructure supporting RV owners, dealers, manufacturers, and roadside assistance workflows.

● Architecting scalable backend services, APIs and relational data models
● Building and refactoring mobile and web experiences using React Native, React and Next.js
● Supporting subscription, payment, notification and location-based application workflows
● Managing deployment processes, environment configuration, release coordination and production support
● Contributing to cloud infrastructure, data storage and third-party service integrations
● Creating technical documentation covering system reliability, deployment procedures, monitoring, rollback planning and operational ownership
● Collaborating with engineering, product and external partner teams on architecture, integrations, sprint planning and roadmap execution
● Reviewing security, compliance, access control, backup and data-protection requirements
● Troubleshooting complex application, infrastructure, deployment and mobile release issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed and maintained frontend applications using a mixture of React, React Native, Typescript, Next.js, and tRPC.
● Contributed to the improvement of proprietary web and mobile applications by adding new features,
maintaining code quality, and addressing code-related issues.
● Collaborated with the frontend and backend team to implement new features and enhance existing functionality.
● Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, issues, and errors in the application using strong problem-solving skills.
● Actively participate in daily Scrum/stand-up meetings to provide updates on progress and discuss project requirements.
● Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including UX designers and QA testers, to deliver high-quality software solutions.
● Continuously update knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to enhance development practices and contribute to innovation within the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · React Native · Next.js · Node.js · TypeScript · tRPC · Redux.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Technologies

positions.title: Practice Manager
positions.description:
Manage clinical and administrative team in the Central Texas market in daily operations which consists of four medical clinics and a surgical suite

Conduct staff performances, interviewing and hiring staff personal, training staff, and meeting market performance benchmarks in aesthetics and plastic surgery

Responsible for meeting monthly objectives in patient satisfaction, financial benchmarks, and organizing workflows for staff efficiencies

Organize monthly governor board meetings with Medical Director and Chief General Surgeon to review quality metrics, finance, and business development opportunities

Analyze aesthetic trends in the market and worked with aesthetic sales reps to focus on maximizing revenue and increasing patient retention

Mediate patient complaints and assess areas of improvement for patient experiences

Responsible for the financial health of the organization and developing the budget of the practice and monthly profit and loss statements

Manage provider schedules and assign staff to support optimal patient flow

Implementation of new electronic health/medical record (Nextech) at company, which includes training administrative and clinical staff on new software and hardware assets, and new payment system

Review monthly chart audits to ensure correct and timely charting

Create and maintain a culture of quality and safety to meet the mission statement of the organization and ensure safety of the patient

Review policies and procedures of the practice for compliance of the rules and regulations of the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care (AAAHC), OSHA, and HIPAA

Create and implement marketing strategies, such as Search Engine Optimization (SEOs) and Pay-Per-Clicks (PPCs), monthly promotions and patient events to support growth of market

Develop business strategies for growth of the practice

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description: As Office Manager at Access Dental, I am tasked with managing the day-to-day operations of the dental clinic. This includes being responsible for the financial health for the clinic and meeting the goal for production.

positions.title: Associate Practice Administrator
positions.description:
Served as manager of daily operations of a pediatric and women's wellness clinic. 

Leadership: Met with clinical operations team and clinic staff as required to discuss issues, policies and procedures. Held one-on-one meetings with staff to discuss future goals, clinic improvements, and professional development. Conducted staff meetings, maintained open communication, and encouraged teamwork for all staff. Collaborated with others to provide appropriate training and education to staff in AIDET/LOC and NextGen. Responsible for creating a culture of quality customer service and advocated for patients. 							

Operations: Worked with site leadership on a daily basis to problem solve and manage clinical sites including but not limited to the management of supplies, ordering and storage, communication with vendors, maintenance, repair, and annual inspection of equipment. Coordinated with other managers and site leadership to oversee management of the patient satisfaction program, patient complaint process, compliance program, and quality improvement program for clinics assigned and report as directed. Consulted with clinical operations team to discuss service problems, responded to community needs, enhanced public relations, coordinated activities and plans, and promoted health programs in our organization. 

Financial Acumen: Reviewed and analyzed facility activities and data to aid planning, cash and risk management, and to improve service utilization. Oversaw staff compensation, balanced scorecard initiatives and incentive management. 

Compliance: Have complete ownership of NextGen (both EPM and EMR), including but not limited to designated Superuser status and providing last line of support before escalating problems to the regional level. Coordinated with other managers and site leadership to oversee maintenance of OSHA regulations, CLIA compliance, and Joint Commission readiness.

positions.title: Project Coordinator - Business Development
positions.description:
Prepared report and analysis for developing the Child Abuse and Foster Care of Dell Children’s Health business and financial plan. The plan’s major contents consisted of physician and staff modeling, restructuring of existing space, incremental growth modeling, capital requirements and pro forma. The plan successfully went through initial round of National Access Improvement Program of Department of State Health Services for funding. 

Assisted in the Behavioral Health Model of Dell Children’s Health. Plan consisted of major capital requirements and patient growth modeling in order to move Child Psychiatry from Seton - Shoal Creek and the Texas Child Study Center to DCMC. An initial capital investment of $5.6 million went through first round of leadership approval. 

Collaborated in the expansion of Pediatric ED services of Dell Children’s Health. Pediatric ED expansion were approved to two Seton hospital locations. 

Performed market analysis of Central Texas to explore marketing opportunities, payor mix, patient population, patient growth, disease mapping and service line growth. 

Streamlined and managed new business plan model that consisted of marketing assessment, strategy, operations, staffing model, capital requirements, financials and data compilation in order to improve design/development/execution of business planning support.

positions.title: Freshmen-Interest-Group Mentor
positions.description:
Developed class seminars, projects, and events to engage freshmen in leadership opportunities at UT and in the Austin area

Communicated and collaborated with other mentors, staff and faculty to provide assistance to freshmen

Supported administrative department by taking responsibility of projects and other specific tasks

Became the public health liaison for the School of Natural Sciences for freshmen interested in the public health major
